title: Kagamine Rin — A Reassuring Spell〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Shih and the girls are working really hard again today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The show is just around the corner.
I'm sure they're busy putting on the finishing touches.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure they're going to put on a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too☆ I really can't wait!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I know they're the opening act rather than the headliners, but they really get to perform at that big arena...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It seats fifteen thousand, right?
I also can't believe they get to play in front of such a large audience.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm still having trouble processing that number. What do you think it's going to be like for them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I bet the crowd's gonna roar when they play!
I'm really jealous of how much fun they're gonna have!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I might get a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? I feel like you'd get into a nice groove once the show started.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That being said, Ichika and the girls are dealing with quite a bit of pressure. It sounds like the band they're opening for is very famous.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
It's not all fun and games for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know! What if we came up with a magic spell to help them feel better?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A magic spell?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That way, if they get nervous on stage they don't have to worry!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see what you mean. In that case, why don't the three of us try coming up with one together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... How to feel less nervous...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
How about smiling from ear to ear?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A big smile like this!
I'm feeling better already!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. That's not a bad idea.
It makes me want to smile too, so it helps others relax as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But won't it be a bit difficult to smile when you're feeling nervous?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
It's hard to smile when you're all frozen up...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, scratch that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I think one of the magazines Shiho lent us said something about dealing with nervousness...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that might be just the hint we need.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You gotta remember what it said, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It involved drawing people on your palm or something... And eating them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! You have to eat people?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I think I've heard that before somewhere. You just pretend to gobble them up, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I've never heard of that before!
Lemme give that a try!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see... Pretend to draw some people on my palm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, that's three... No, I'll draw five...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Forget it. I'm gonna draw as many as I can, and... Nom!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... I don't think it worked? I'm not really sure though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, these kinds of things probably don't work very well if you don't understand the meaning behind them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't we try a different idea? For example, we can think about us instead.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. When you're feeling nervous, Rin, what would help make you feel better?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... If I were feeling nervous...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Having you and KAITO next to me would do the trick, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Knowing that people I love are right there next to me would make me feel invincible☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we think of a spell that makes it feel like the people you care about are with you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Those we care about...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what if we modified the thing we just did?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Instead of drawing people, you could write the names of people you really care about and gobble those up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Their names...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, like this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll write your name, MEIKO, since you're always hanging out with me and giving me great advice! And your name, KAITO, since you're quiet but super reliable!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next, Luka, because she's so nice and always watches over me♪ And Miku-P because she does such a great job of leading us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, and Len since we always practice and have contests together and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nom...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (My chest feels all warm for some reason...!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did it work...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it did!
It's like you're all right here with me now☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, it must be an effective spell.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thanks for helping me with this, MEIKO, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to teach the girls this♪
